questions.scenario: You get a magical pair of glasses. What do you want to see through them?

options.text: Zoom into the night sky to see hidden planets and galaxies.
Zoom into human skin to see how cells and DNA actually work.
Zoom into a solid wall to see the invisible atoms and molecules.
Zoom deep underground to see hidden water and dinosaur fossils.

questions.scenario: Which of these YouTube videos would you click on immediately?

options.text: What happens if you fall into a Black Hole?
Can we bring dead animals back to life using DNA?
Mixing 10 dangerous chemicals together (Explosion Experiment).
Exploring the deepest, darkest parts of the Ocean.

questions.scenario: Your school is taking you on a special field trip. Where do you want to go?

options.text: A giant Planetarium or an ISRO rocket launchpad.
A medical museum showing how human bodies are made.
A high-tech lab with lasers, robots, and bubbling chemicals.
A trek inside a massive natural cave system or a volcano.

questions.scenario: If you could create a new sci-fi invention, what would it be?

options.text: A spaceship that travels faster than the speed of light.
A magic pill that cures any disease and stops aging.
A machine that turns normal rocks into pure gold.
A machine that cleans the air and controls the weather.

questions.scenario: You find a mysterious, glowing object in the forest. What is your first thought?

options.text: 'Is this a meteorite from an alien planet?'
'Is this a new mutated plant or insect?'
'What chemical elements is this made of? Will it explode?'
'Is this a rare crystal formed by a volcano?'

questions.scenario: Which of these 'boring' tasks would you tolerate without getting angry?

options.text: Sitting outside in the cold all night just to spot one shooting star.
Waiting 3 days just to see a small bacteria grow in a glass dish.
Carefully washing 50 fragile test tubes so they are perfectly clean.
Walking in deep mud and rain just to collect a soil sample.

questions.scenario: Which massive 'Unsolved Mystery' keeps you awake at night?

options.text: Are we alone in this huge universe?
How did the first living cell actually form?
What is the smallest, invisible particle made of?
What creatures are hiding at the bottom of the ocean?

questions.scenario: You are playing a survival video game. What is your main strategy?

options.text: Building a rocket to escape the planet.
Mixing plants to make health potions and medicines.
Crafting cool weapons, bombs, and armors using metals.
Exploring the map, surviving storms, and mining rocks.

questions.scenario: What poster or wallpaper would you put in your bedroom?

options.text: A beautiful glowing galaxy or an astronaut.
A cool glowing DNA strand or a wild animal.
The Periodic Table or a famous scientist like Einstein.
A map of the world or a massive ocean wave.

questions.scenario: In a team of superheroes, what would be your title?

options.text: The Stargazer (The Space Explorer).
The Mutator (The Life Creator).
The Alchemist (The Matter Manipulator).
The Earth-Keeper (The Force of Nature).
